blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — A fish kill episode has been reported along parts of the coastline of Odiongan, with the Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) linking it to the extreme heat and rising seawater temperatures associated with the ongoing El Niño. Dally Jean Florendo of the Odiongan MAO said affected areas include Barangay Canduyong and portions of Barangays Libertad and Gabawan, according to a report from the Philippine Information Agency in Romblon on Wednesday (Oct. 7).
